advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: I spent 10 years of my career at that firm until I left in 2009 to start my own
advice_items.summary_en: Spend years learning inside an established, reputable firm before launching your own company.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在老牌强企深耕十年再独立创业

advice_items.quote: my day begins probably around 5 30. and I'm at the office by 6 15 the latest
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a disciplined schedule starting early in the morning, staying late, and holding weekly individual review meetings.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持早起进办公室与每周复盘的铁律

advice_items.quote: brokers in this business they're not transactional they are relationship Centric
advice_items.summary_en: Build lifelong, repeat client relationships rather than treating deals as one-off transactions; landing five active clients can set you up.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重长期客户关系，拿下五个活跃大客户

advice_items.quote: no salary means that there's no ceiling I can make as much money as possible
advice_items.summary_en: Embrace commission-only upside because having no fixed salary means having no ceiling on your income.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢选无底薪赛道，不给收入设上限

advice_items.quote: I started at 5 30 in the morning arriving at the office staying till 6 PM that I went to a job working at night
advice_items.summary_en: Endure the long early runway with extreme grit—working side jobs at night and on weekends if needed while building your business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 熬过两年无单期，打三份工扛住前期压力

advice_items.quote: I was able to buy my first deal using the commission earned from these transactions
advice_items.summary_en: Use commissions earned from brokerage deals to buy your own real estate properties.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用经纪业务赚取的佣金买下个人商业地产

advice_items.quote: he invited me over I sat and I watched them learned as much as I could
advice_items.summary_en: Research a mentor's personal interests to get in the room, ask to be taught, and observe closely before expecting business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投其所好破冰大佬，近身观摩向导师学习

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Start Directly in Commercial Real Estate
advice_items.quote: I don't recommend it because the process is completely different
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid starting in residential real estate to transition into commercial later unless you already have substantial capital; start directly in commercial.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别从住宅地产迂回转型，直接切入商业地产

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: by year five you're making seven figures yeah without question after a decade you're making probably 10 million dollars or more
advice_items.summary_en: Pick a high-upside industry like commercial real estate where mastering database building, relationships, and proposals can reach seven figures in five years.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选高天花板赛道，做对五年即可年入百万

advice_items.quote: you could just go online and Google and find so much information about an owner so information is gold
advice_items.summary_en: Take advantage of online search and modern tools to research property owners, as information is gold.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用互联网与搜索工具挖掘业主黄金信息

guests.first_money_or_break: 1999年毫无经验进入纽约一家老牌商业地产经纪公司，在无底薪期间靠白天做经纪、晚上餐厅打工（时薪10-12美元）及周末卖尼桑汽车三份工度日；坚持近两年后于2001年8月在纽约宾厄姆顿成交首单获5.4万美元佣金，随后用布朗克斯公寓楼交易佣金买下自己首个地产项目，并于2009年创立个人经纪公司。
guests.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Broker & Brokerage Founder
guests.zero_start_advice: 建议新人直接从商业地产起步而非先做住宅地产（除非已攒下巨额资金）；入行前需做好财务支撑，扛过6至12个月无成交期；专注建立长期复购客户关系（拿下5个活跃客户即可站稳），先在成熟大公司历练并寻找导师，善用网络工具挖掘业主信息，保持高强度自律作息。
